risks.risk: P06 samples one bounded observability smoke window; longer time-series cadence is left to later soak and scale phases.
risks.notes: Not blocking because the P06 manifest requires an observability smoke proof, which is present and schema-valid.

rationale: All P06 manifest gates ran and passed with command text matching the manifest and stdout/stderr SHA256 values matching gate_result.json. Required artifacts exist and validate, metrics_timeseries.jsonl and events.jsonl validate line-by-line, real Valkey evidence proves six live Valkey 9.1.0 nodes with cluster ok and data path PASS, metrics include Valkey, cluster, Docker/process, and log fields, cleanup reports no remaining resources, live Docker label checks found no owned P06 containers or networks, and no safety violation was found.
